page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with a running head at the top and the page number at the top right. Below the text, FINIS centred. No margin notes.

main_text.p: bus sibi ministrari putat Beveregius abunde etiam vel à Dallæo vel à nobis satisfactum est, necnon iis omnibus quæ à vetustioribus Scriptoribus & ab antiquis deprompsit Synodis ad eandem Canonum antiquitatem stabiliendam ac confirmandam. Qua-mobrem hîc sisto gradum, etsi plures ad-huc in annotationes Beveregianas fieri possent observationes, cum in eas quibus Canones illustravit Apostolicos, tum in alias quibus cæteris Canonibus aliquam lucem afferre conatus est: sed ne scribendi cacoë-the me laborare putet eruditissimus Beveregius, hoc labore haud invitus superse-deo: Eo magis quod præstantissimum Dal-læum Virum nunquam satis laudatum ad-versus duos celeberrimos adversarios tue-ri ac defendere tantùm mihi propositum fuit: an id recte præstiterim necne, alio-rum esto judicium.

page.notes: The first line begins with a fragment ("bus"), which is kept as printed. Hyphenated line breaks are kept with their printed hyphens. The reading "necne" is set as printed in the scan, which is slightly blurred at that point. The stamp and the digitiser's watermark are left out.
